title: Touch UI
description: Disables controller mode, routes Input.touchCount / GetTouch to the legacy touch provider and gives Input's mouse and keyboard natives to Touchscreen Mode's touchpad and keys, and, in Touch pointer mode (DM_POINTER_MODE=touch), hides the game's cursor by replacing Cursor.SetCursor and Cursor.set_visible, and lets the inventory lists (combat pages, key pages, burning books, passive succession) scroll by dragging
